items.title: Astroid with unequal intercepts
paragraphs: The even cube-root squares make the equation symmetric about both coordinate axes. The origin does not satisfy the equation. The notebook supplies these initial observations.
PankusDesk completion: use \(x=a\cos^3t,y=b\sin^3t\). This satisfies the equation since cos²t+sin²t=1, and covers the bounded curve.

The intercepts are (±a,0),(0,±b), with cusp tangents y=0 at the first pair and x=0 at the second. There are no asymptotes. No astroid sketch is supplied in the notebook; no substitute drawing has been generated.
items.final_answer: A closed four-cusped curve contained in \(|x|\le a,|y|\le b\).
